issue_request: FHIR-17299 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for the Security WG and asked that the AuditEvent disclosure example explain what is being recorded and why by expanding its text narrative.

Commit 4af66cb9b0e7b2d14f39a4eecfb660d55ff964c9 later removed that narrative during the FHIR-33155 AuditEvent patient/entity cleanup.
additional_context: AuditEvent is active in source/fhir.ini and AuditEvent/example-disclosure is listed in source/auditevent/list-AuditEvent-examples.xml. FHIR-44746 later restored AuditEvent type/subtype terminology, so the reconciled narrative uses the current element names and values rather than the intermediate category/code labels. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
